entities.name: Ghen
entities.description: A Human Wizard from an unknown plane who can see the strands of mana in an enchantment, take them apart and reweave them.

events.summary: Ghen is known to snatch someone's spell out of the air and reweave it in front of them.
events.quote: He has been known to snatch someone's spell out of the air and reweave it in front of them.
